title: The Keynote Clean title page draws its starfield without square blocks around the glows
goal: The Keynote Clean title page background shows hard-edged dark rectangles around many of its soft glows, at 1920 by 1080 and at Retina size, in the picture the exporter draws. The glows should fade into the background with no visible boxes.
acceptance: A frame of a Keynote Clean page 2.5 seconds in, drawn as export draws it, shows no rectangle edges around any glow at 1920 by 1080 or at 3456 by 2234
An exported MP4 of a Keynote Clean page shows the same
Other moving title backgrounds checked the same way and named in the log

log.note: Reproduced on current code with a new test (LiveBackdropSeamTests) that renders through DocumentRenderer.render(doc.drawn(atTimeMS:)), the export path: Keynote Clean at 2.5 s had 218 straight seams at 1920x1080 (longest 151 px, step 33 levels) and 268 at 3456x2234 (longest 313 px). Cause: the particles shader evaluated each pixel against its own grid cell only, so every speck's halo was cut off at the cell edge.

Fix (Sources/PhotonzRender/LiveBackdrops.swift, live_particles): each pixel sums the specks of the 3x3 neighbouring cells, and the halo fades smoothly to nothing by 1.15 cells so even the smallest Scale stays inside the neighbourhood. Keynote: 0 seams at both sizes. Particles at default and Depth 100: 0.

Checked every other moving look the same way (default and knob at 100, 1080p, 2.5 s). Energy Streams had real cuts: at long Trail the trail stopped dead at exp(-trail) with a dark notch (step 91, 137 px tall); the packet glow was also a box with a straight front at the default (Stacked Stagger uses it). Fixed: the trail fades to zero at its tail, the packet glow narrows with brightness (comet shape), and the head fades in over 0.10 of phase instead of 0.04. Sketch and Grid Horizon draw straight lines on purpose (looked at, no boxes, so the test leaves them out). Aurora, Color Bubbles, Light Rays, Light Leaks, Wind Streams and Liquid Gradient show only 1-level-a-channel 8-bit banding, not cuts.

Chose to fix Energy Streams in this task instead of filing it, because it is the same defect (a glow cut off at a straight edge) and acceptance 3 asks for the other looks to be checked. Perf: Particles 3.8 -> 5.1 ms, Energy Streams 4.1 -> 4.5 ms per 1080p frame on the calibration clock (budget 21.8).

Export verified on the probe through the agent tools (new_video, add_title Keynote Clean, video_frame 2.5 s, export mp4 full) at 1920x1080 and 3456x2234; ffmpeg frames at 2.5 s show no boxes. Full Scripts/test.sh green. Audit: queue/audits/2026-11-11-keynote-clean-no-boxes.json. No walk touched.
owns no walks; the ones it names are examples

Keynote Clean's specks no longer sit in dark boxes: the particles look now reads the 3x3 neighbouring cells and fades each halo out inside them (LiveBackdrops.swift). Energy Streams' cut-off packets fixed too. New LiveBackdropSeamTests: Keynote Clean went from 218/268 seams to 0 at 1080p and 3456x2234; probe export at both sizes checked frame by frame; full suite green. Audit 2026-11-11-keynote-clean-no-boxes.json.
